intro: Sneak in. Strike fast. Escape rich.
description:
Silent Raid is a fast-paced stealth action game where every move matters. Slip through dangerous areas, avoid enemy vision, strike at the perfect moment, and grab the loot before the whole map turns against you.

Play as a swift knife-wielding infiltrator and outsmart armed guards in tense, close-quarters encounters. Use cover, timing, and smart positioning to stay unseen, eliminate threats, and survive high-risk raids packed with danger and reward.

With quick missions, satisfying stealth-combat gameplay, and easy-to-learn controls, Silent Raid delivers intense action in short bursts — perfect for players who love stealth, precision, and tactical decision-making.
